fixture: Fair arrival sets the wallet. Later-day fixtures run on Saturday at 10:00 with no outstanding prayers. c07 sets five coins. c16 earns the LOCK 1/2 states with their live wallet and trust.
method: Native Godot viewport. Production GUI buttons receive viewport-local mouse clicks. Passive clock ticks are paused.

lines: By morning word has spread. 16 people are waiting at the inn door.
Yusuf walks past with Ali, who is on his feet again. He tells the whole street who paid.
Faris runs past the quay in new shoes.
Salma shakes her head: Tariq’s house never burned. He tries it on every new traveller - and now he is telling everyone how easy you were.
The inn door is quiet this morning.
Yusuf tells everyone Rania was paid by someone he never saw. He does not know it was you.
Warm bread has been left at your door. You never find out who left it.
By morning word has spread. 8 people are waiting at the inn door.
Umm Salim keeps her eyes down when she sees you. Half the street watched her take your coins.
Nobody is waiting any more. People say the foreigner keeps his purse shut.
Cut a corner, then put it right
